verdict: Shopify closed 2025 with revenue up 31% to $3,672M on a record $123.8B of merchant sales — operating income rose 36% to $631M and net income was $743M, helped by a $182M gain on its investment stakes.

kpis.label: GMV
kpis.note: merchant sales through the platform, +31% YoY

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: Monthly fees merchants pay to use the Shopify platform. Up 17% YoY.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Payment processing, shipping and other services that grow with merchant sales. Up 35% YoY as GMV hit a record.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and winning new merchants. Up 24% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Building the platform and new commerce and AI features. Up 11% YoY.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: The back office — finance, legal and admin. Up 12% YoY.

opex.name: Transaction and loan losses
opex.note: Losses on merchant loans and cash advances, and transaction losses. Up 50% YoY.

follow100Note: Merchant solutions — mostly payment processing that grows with merchant sales — are $78.84 of every $100 Shopify takes in.
otherDetail: Other income of $261M net (including the separate equity-method line) combined a $248M gain on equity and other investments and $79M of other income, net — mostly interest income — partly offset by a $94M loss on the embedded derivative tied to Shopify's convertible notes, which were settled in the quarter; the equity-method investment (Flexport) added a $28M gain, shown on the separate equity line.
footerNote: Excluding the gains on equity investments, Shopify's own measure of net income was $594M. The GAAP net income was $743M.

takeaways.title: A record holiday quarter
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 31% to $3,672M and merchants sold a record $123.8B through the platform (GMV, also +31%). Full-year revenue grew 30% to $11.6B.

takeaways.title: Operating profit kept compounding
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 36% to $631M, and free cash flow was $715M — a 19% margin, the tenth straight quarter of double-digit free-cash-flow margins. Shopify also launched a $2B share repurchase program.

takeaways.title: Investment gains helped, but were smaller than last year
takeaways.text: Net income was $743M, down from $1,293M a year ago — that quarter's investment gains were far larger ($906M vs $182M this quarter). Excluding equity-investment gains, net income was $594M.

oneTimers: Convertible-note derivative: a $94M loss on the embedded derivative held to settle Shopify's convertible senior notes, which were settled in the quarter (the full-year loss was $123M).

Equity investments: a $248M net gain on equity and other investments in the quarter, mostly mark-to-market (paper) gains that can reverse — Shopify's own net income excluding equity investments was $594M.

sources.label: Form 10-K for the year ended Dec 31, 2025 — quarterly data (SEC EDGAR)
